newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb unemployment up at 5.55 percent - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb unemployment up at 5.55 percent - IBGE.

text.p: Brazil's February unemployment rate increased to 5.55 percent from 5.14 percent in January, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
However, the unemployment rate fell in comparison with February 1996 when it stood at 5.7 percent, the IBGE said.

The number of people out of work fell 2.6 percent in February, compared with February 1996, in the six main urban centers surveyed, the IBGE said. Belo Horizonte and Porto Alegre saw the biggest falls in unemployment at 12.8 percent and six percent, respectively.
The number of people out of work in February increased, however, in Rio de Janeiro and Salvador when compared with February last year by 3.3 percent and 2.7 percent, respectively, the IBGE said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
